Source Directory

  • CURIE: gmeow:SourceDirectory
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SourceDirectory
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/software

A content-addressed subdirectory within a source tree — a named container of files and nested directories. A specialization of gmeow:SourceTree for nested structure.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:SourceTree

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:SourceDirectory as a specialized kind of gmeow:SourceTree. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
